summary:
Independent non-author mechanical Sol glue review by Gemini 4 Argon (High) via AGY (self-reported harness model identity, not an independent attestation; one read-only attempt using view_file only; no shell, hashing, AST, import, compilation, or execution). Scope is strictly limited to the non-security mechanical Sol renderer copy, call wiring, and metadata serialization/copying in build_k10_inputs_r4.py (61911 bytes, 1296 lines, sha256 5e18724529aaa9ab8c00786fdce6951cc9f83c5c05a4f329b020a7f4aa8da7d6 as recorded by root). Although all 1296 lines of build_k10_inputs_r4.py were viewed across two read-only file views to verify module-wide bindings and call paths, no global 1296-line security, cryptographic, JSON, bridge, or filesystem writer audit is claimed; Opus owns all security and precondition acceptance judgments.

1. Literal Function Copy Comparison (by Direct Source View):
- SOL-RENDERER.py.txt is 36 lines (1544 bytes). Lines 1-6 are the standalone fragment module docstring and lines 7-8 are two blank lines (298 bytes total: 68+1+77+82+64+4+1+1 bytes), which are not part of the function definition and are appropriately omitted in build_k10_inputs_r4.py so as not to introduce a stray mid-module string expression.
- Lines 9-35 of SOL-RENDERER.py.txt (27 lines, 1246 bytes including trailing LF) define def _render_prepared_outputs(code_hex, policy, case_rows, manifest_fields). Direct line-by-line and character-by-character comparison against build_k10_inputs_r4.py lines 969-995 confirms an exact byte-for-byte match across all 27 lines.
- _render_prepared_outputs appears as exactly one effective copy in build_k10_inputs_r4.py (defined once at lines 969-995, called once at line 1019 in plan_outputs, never rebound or shadowed).

2. Module Bindings, Imports, and Non-Shadowing:
- The prefix imports json (line 32) and build_k10_inputs as legacy (line 37) among the 9 permitted imports (lines 31-39).
- The tail is appended below the single seam (# === C2B-R4-APPEND-SEAM: append tail below; prefix above is immutable === at line 570), adds no imports, and never rebinds, patches, or shadows legacy, json, c2_issue_artifacts_r2, host_codec, or any prefix gate/constant at module or local scope.
- c2_issue_artifacts (v1) is never imported or referenced, no /2-to-/1 format or label conversion exists, and no eager execution of builder gates or rendering occurs at import time.

3. Mechanical Call Order and Prepared Row/Manifest Dataflow (Actual Source Path):
- In main(argv) (lines 1262-1292), actual call order is _admit_argv(argv) (line 1276) -> _open_outdir(args[5], state) (line 1277) -> _read_inputs(args) (line 1278) -> plan_outputs(raws[0], raws[1], raws[2], expiry) (line 1279) -> _write_outputs(files, args, raws, state) (line 1280).
- In plan_outputs (lines 999-1023), actual call order before the renderer is: (1) _admit_expiry_int(expiry) (line 1007); (2) parse_public_json(export_raw, _EXPORT_CAP) (line 1008); (3) parse_public_json(setup_raw, _SETUP_CAP) (line 1009); (4) check_setup_link(export, setup_raw) (line 1010); (5) _policy_gate(b9_raw) (line 1011); (6) _consume(export, setup, expiry, facts['policy']) calling c2_issue_artifacts_r2.prepare_c2_issue once by attribute at call time (line 1012 / line 788); (7) _bridge_gate(result, export, setup, expiry, facts['policy'], link) (line 1013); (8) rows = _prepare_rows(checked) (line 1014); (9) fields = _manifest_fields(checked, facts, link, expiry, (b9_raw, export_raw, setup_raw)) (line 1015); and (10) files = _render_prepared_outputs(facts['code_hex'], facts['policy'], rows, fields) (line 1019), followed by the 6-file roster postcondition check (lines 1020-1022). Upstream gate preconditions are cited here as source declarations and mechanical call order only, not certified.
- _prepare_rows(checked) (lines 904-921) builds an exact 4-tuple of row dicts via _case_row (lines 894-901) in (T1, T5, T6, T7) order: T1 (checked['env_tree'], checked['token'], qty 1), T5 (_translated_env(checked['env_data'], env_cbor), checked['token'], qty 2), T6 (_translated_env(checked['env_data'], env_cbor), legacy.flip_first_bit(token), qty 1), and T7 (checked['t7_tree'], checked['t7_token'], qty 1, checked['t7_cbor'], checked['bad_vk_digest']). Each row dict has exact keys {'env', 'token', 'quantity', 'vk', 'proof', 'manifest'}, and row['manifest'] is a fresh dict with the 6 Opus-computed metadata keys (envelopeCborHex, tokenNameHex, quantity, envVkDigestHex, envStatementDigestHex, proofHexSha256).

4. Serialization, Non-Mutation in Renderer Source, and Non-Claims:
- _render_prepared_outputs unpacks t1, t5, t6, t7 = case_rows, pairs them with the 4 fixed historical case IDs (K10-T1-positive-genuine-issue, K10-T5-quantity-two-reject, K10-T6-token-name-bitflip-reject, K10-T7-vk-digest-bitflip-reject), writes 'script.hex' as (code_hex + '\n').encode('utf-8'), calls legacy.script_context and legacy.uplc_term once per row to format 'contexts/<case_id>.uplc.txt' as ('(con data (%s))\n' % legacy.uplc_term(context)).encode('utf-8'), copies each row['manifest'] via dict(row['manifest']) before adding only 'id' and 'contextFile' (producing all 8 _CASE_KEYS), copies manifest_fields via dict(manifest_fields) before setting manifest['cases'] = manifest_cases (producing all 33 _MANIFEST_KEYS), and formats 'manifest.json' via (json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8').
- _manifest_fields constructs fresh container copies for nested dicts and lists (auditSourcePins, builderLabels, consumerLabels, coverageGaps for T2-T4 with NOT_GENERATED_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ONLY, flags with all 10 flags False, inputs, limitations, settleOutref).
- Static inspection confirms the renderer body only serializes and copies prepared metadata without mutating input dicts/lists or creating/claiming security outcomes. No runtime execution success, runtime non-mutation proof of external functions, or Opus precondition validation is claimed.
